description.value: Bean Around The World is a BC coffee roaster with over 30 years of history, hand-roasting small batches daily at their North Vancouver roastery headquarters. The business operates physical café locations alongside a full online shop offering beans, brew gear, apparel, and subscriptions. A touring cyclist stopping here would find a well-established local coffee institution with a broad selection of single-origins and blends.
